mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 6% in 3 months, signaling labor market weakening, S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 6%, or IC > 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDPC1 (demand) alongside a decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) creates a positive signal for S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (e.g., IC < 0.05) or returns are negative despite the proxies moving in the expected direction.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS leads to higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle periods, FEDFUNDS declines do not correlate with positive returns (p>0.05), or IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply growth) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) during INDPRO's upward trend, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% in 1 month, indicating a strong labor market, S&P 500 returns are expected to be positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 5%, or IC < 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) creates a positive signal for S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05) or returns are negative despite the proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a contractionary labor market regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS leads to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In contractionary labor markets, FEDFUNDS declines do not correlate with positive returns (p>0.05), or IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.
